sysjob.name: SSIS Failover Monitor Job
sysjob.description: Runs every 2 minutes. This job execute master.dbo.sp_ssis_startup if detect AlwaysOn failover on SSISDB.

sysjobstep.command: DECLARE @role int DECLARE @status tinyint SET @role = (SELECT [role] FROM [sys].[dm_hadr_availability_replica_states] hars INNER JOIN [sys].[availability_databases_cluster] adc ON hars.[group_id] = adc.[group_id] WHERE hars.[is_local] = 1 AND adc.[database_name] ='SSISDB') IF @role = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SSISDB].[internal].[refresh_replica_status] @server_name = @@SERVERNAME, @status = @status OUTPUT IF @status = 1 EXEC [SSISDB].[catalog].[startup] END

sysjob.name: SSIS Server Maintenance Job
sysjob.description: Runs every day. The job removes operation records from the database that are outside the retention window and maintains a maximum number of versions per project.

sysjobstep.command: DECLARE @role int SET @role = (SELECT [role] FROM [sys].[dm_hadr_availability_replica_states] hars INNER JOIN [sys].[availability_databases_cluster] adc ON hars.[group_id] = adc.[group_id] WHERE hars.[is_local] = 1 AND adc.[database_name] ='SSISDB') IF DB_ID('SSISDB') IS NOT NULL AND (@role IS NULL OR @role = 1) EXEC [SSISDB].[internal].[cleanup_server_retention_window]

sysjobstep.step_name: SSIS Server Max Version Per Project Maintenance
sysjobstep.command: DECLARE @role int SET @role = (SELECT [role] FROM [sys].[dm_hadr_availability_replica_states] hars INNER JOIN [sys].[availability_databases_cluster] adc ON hars.[group_id] = adc.[group_id] WHERE hars.[is_local] = 1 AND adc.[database_name] ='SSISDB') IF DB_ID('SSISDB') IS NOT NULL AND (@role IS NULL OR @role = 1) EXEC [SSISDB].[internal].[cleanup_server_project_version]
